class.name: StyleBoxCSSHelper
class.brief_description: Converts Godot StyleBoxes to CSS declarations and back.
class.description: Converts [StyleBoxFlat], [StyleBoxEmpty], [StyleBoxLine], and [StyleBoxTexture] using Dockit's CSS parser and layout engine. Results contain an [enum Error] value in [code]error[/code] and a [PackedStringArray] in [code]diagnostics[/code]. A successful conversion may still report properties that cannot be represented exactly. CSS contains standard declarations. Runtime textures are supplied separately; no private CSS properties or temporary files are generated. Conversion preserves the supported appearance, not the original resource's type or every Godot drawing parameter.

method.name: stylebox_to_css
method.description: Returns [code]css[/code], [code]textures[/code], [code]error[/code], and [code]diagnostics[/code]. Pass the texture dictionary to the matching HTML resource context. Texture regions and modulation are baked into an in-memory texture when needed. The conversion cache is invalidated when the StyleBox emits [signal Resource.changed].

method.name: css_to_stylebox
method.description: Converts a CSS declaration block in an isolated element context. Returns [code]stylebox[/code], [code]error[/code], and [code]diagnostics[/code]. [param target_type] accepts [code]auto[/code], [code]flat[/code], [code]empty[/code], [code]line[/code], or [code]texture[/code]. Auto chooses Texture for a border image and Flat otherwise. [param context] accepts [code]textures[/code], [code]base_dir[/code], [code]viewport_size[/code], [code]box_size[/code], [code]font_size[/code], [code]root_font_size[/code], and [code]vertical[/code] for lines. Supply referenced border-image textures in [code]textures[/code]. CSS layout, fonts, multiple shadows, and properties unsupported by the selected StyleBox cannot be restored as equivalent StyleBox properties.
